enable_client.description: Enable client mode (required for client options)

enable_worker.description: Enable worker mode (required for worker options)

functions.description: List of function names to register (mapped via -f)

job_server_host.description: Job server hostname or IP (mapped via -h)

job_server_port.description: Job server port (mapped via -p); empty means use default or GEARMAN_SERVER

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds (mapped via -t); 0 means no timeout

one_job_per_line.description: Run one job per line (mapped via -n)

one_job_per_line_no_newline.description: Run one job per line, stripping trailing newline (mapped via -N)

high_priority.description: Submit jobs with high priority (mapped via -I)

low_priority.description: Submit jobs with low priority (mapped via -L)

prefix_output.description: Prefix output lines with function names (mapped via -P)

send_without_stdin.description: Send job without reading from stdin (mapped via -s)

worker_max_jobs.description: Maximum jobs for worker to run before exiting (mapped via -c); 0 means infinite
